subject: partner/custom skill domain boundary
conclusion: Evidence supports modeling partner/custom skill availability as a separate relationship/domain layer rather than treating every partner-only availability as a new canonical CaC skill record.

evidence.claim: Dual Masenko is a canonical Xenoverse 2 Super Skill and is obtainable by the Future Warrior from the TP Medal Shop; it is also available in Future Trunks' Customize Partner skillset.
Future Trunks' Custom Partner skill list explicitly includes Dual Masenko.
Partner Customization has dedicated custom-partner skill tables, distinct from ordinary mentor acquisition.
evidence.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki / Partner Customization

schema_decision: Do not create a second skill record for Dual Masenko solely because it appears in a partner/custom skillset.
Represent partner/custom availability as a relationship from an existing skill ID to a partner/character endpoint when the canonical skill already exists.

If a partner-only move is not present in the canonical 474-skill corpus, create a separate partner/custom skill domain only after establishing that it is genuinely unavailable to the Future Warrior/CaC, rather than assuming partner-only status from a reward list.
pq118: PQ118 should not be used as the canonical acquisition endpoint for Dual Masenko based on the reviewed evidence. Current evidence identifies TP Medal Shop acquisition and Partner Customization availability; a third-party PQ guide conflicts with that boundary.
unresolved: Whether the canonical 474-skill corpus intentionally excludes character/partner-only skills beyond acquisition availability; this requires a corpus/schema audit, not a new duplicate record.
